mentions.name: container-compose-plugin
mentions.description: A plugin that runs a full Docker system inside Apple Container machines, with automatic localhost port forwarding, automatic shutdown when nothing is running, and an exposed TCP socket so most existing tools work by simply exporting the DOCKER_HOST environment variable.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://robertderose.github.io/container-compose-plugin/

It’s a full docker system running inside Apple Container’s machines with automatic localhost port forwarding, automatic shutdown if nothing is running, and exposes a tcp socket so you can use most tools by just exporting your DOCKER_HOST environment variable.
mentions.author: monster2control
